# Contributing

All kinds of contributions are welcome: bug reports, fixes, features, docs and tests.

## Making a change

1. Fork the repo and create a branch from `main`.
2. Keep the change focused. One fix or feature per pull request.
3. Add or update tests when you change behavior.
4. Make sure the build and tests pass.
5. Open a pull request and say what changed and why.

## Code

- Follow the style of the surrounding code.
- Comment only when the reason is not obvious from the code.
- Do not edit `metrics/Metrics.java`. It is the stock bStats file.
- New config options go in the matching yml file with a one-line comment, and need a sane default in code.

## Bugs

Open an issue with the plugin version, server software and version, what you did, what you expected, and the console log if there is an error.
